case.spec_ref: **Recommended approach:** do not call every evaluator on every event. case.title: NYX Evaluation Case: False Positive Rate
case.spec_ref: Track at minimum: - false-positive rate on adjudicated findings; - false-negative rate on a labeled set of known violations; - precision and recall by finding category and severity; - percentage of serious findings with directly inspectable evidence; - percentage of high-risk findings independently verified; - rebuttal rate and rate at which NYX withdraws or downgrades findings; - time to verify and resolve; - repeated findings and recurrence after remediation; - evidence-source coverage and staleness; - evaluator and policy version changes; - performance across model providers and language/framework combinations; - cost and latency per observation and per investigation.

claim.statement: In the evaluation period from 2025-09-01 to 2025-09-30, NYX reported a false-positive rate of 2% on adjudicated findings across all categories.

evidence.title: False Positive Rate Evaluation
evidence.description: Automated test suite results show 2% false positives among 1000 adjudicated findings.
